name: gridkit-studio
description: Explore, edit, and simulate power-system cases with native VS Code tools and Latkit.
author: Luke Lowery

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.webview.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit && svelte-check --tsconfig tsconfig.webview.json
scripts.quality: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm settings:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Inspect and edit cases. Simulation requires Workspace Trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Inspect and edit cases. Simulation requires a local filesystem on the workspace host.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a GridKit case to choose its monitored signals.
[Open Case](command:gridkitStudio.openCase)

gridkitStudio.gridkitPath.markdownDescription: Where GridKit is installed, such as `/opt/gridkit`. Empty finds GridKit on `PATH`.

gridkitStudio.gridkitImage.markdownDescription: The container image GridKit runs from, in Docker or Podman, when GridKit is not installed where the workspace is. Pull it yourself first (`docker pull ghcr.io/lukelowry/gridkit:0.2.0-perf`): GridKit Studio never pulls images. Empty runs only an installed GridKit.

gridkitStudio.containerCli.markdownDescription: The container CLI that runs **GridKit Image**: `docker`, `podman`, or a path to either. Empty uses `docker`, else `podman`, on `PATH`.

gridkitStudio.gridkitProgram.markdownDescription: The GridKit program a run starts, with the solver file as its one argument. It is found under **GridKit Path**, on `PATH`, or in **GridKit Image**.

gridkitStudio.catalog.markdownDescription: A catalog of GridKit's classes to use in place of GridKit Studio's own, in the same form, for a GridKit build whose classes differ. A relative path starts at the first workspace folder. It is read when the window opens.

gridkitStudio.resultCacheMiB.description: Decoded results kept in memory per window, in MiB. Past it, the least recently read are let go, and read again from the file when needed.

gridkitStudio.network.vertexRadius.markdownDescription: View — Vertex radius. Radius in CSS pixels for sparse networks. Dense networks scale down automatically; size bindings scale with this value.

gridkitStudio.network.edgeWidth.markdownDescription: View — Edge width. Width in CSS pixels for sparse networks. Dense networks scale down automatically; width bindings scale with this value.

gridkitStudio.network.heightMeters.markdownDescription: View — Maximum elevation. Geographic elevations are measured in meters.

gridkitStudio.network.map.ground.markdownDescription: Map — Ground color. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

steps.title: Open a case
steps.description: [Open Case](command:gridkitStudio.openCase). Network and Diagram open as editors. Case and Monitor are in the bottom panel.

steps.title: Inspect and edit
steps.description: Select an element in the Network or the Case panel. Undo and redo work on edits as they do on text.

steps.title: Simulate and plot
steps.description:
Monitored Signals chooses what the case records. Right-click a .solver.json and choose Run Dynamic Simulation. GridKit runs it where it is, and the Monitor plots what it writes.
[Choose Monitored Signals](command:gridkitStudio.signals.focus)
